records.name: LCM-8 (Mike Boat) American Landing Craft Mechanized (LCM)
records.status: provisional; exact historical service interval unknown
records.note: ODIN reports 1959. Navy ACU TWO history says it began shifting to LCM-8 in 1957, while 1959 refers to an organizational merger. US operation is supported; the first introduction milestone conflicts. Continued service and exact variant fit remain unknown. The game permits slot-based cargo, not a real assertion that an M1A2 fits this craft.

records.name: UH-60L Black Hawk American Utility Helicopter
records.status: provisional; exact historical service interval unknown
records.note: ODIN labels UH-60L but reports 1979. Army history associates 1979 with the Black Hawk family/A model and dates L-model production to 1989. The geographic rules reject this variant before 1989; the catalog source remains unchanged. Exact entry into service and retirement remain unknown. Rotary-wing cargo is not enabled by this authored profile.
